description:
Fixes Hide gift button missing the visible composer gift.

- v1.1.0 only neutered the gift push in the attach-sheet actions row, so the composer-bar icon survived. v1.1.1 also forces the shouldShowGiftButton load to false in ChatInputActionButtonRightActions (the visible gift/emoji row): gift skipped, emoji kept.
- Both patches cover 343.12 / 342.16 / 341.13 Stable.
- Verified: official Morphe CLI applies the bundle to all three stable APKs with exactly the expected bytes changed at each site (14 per bundle) and no strays; classes.dex confirmed present.
